newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, still in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends near highs, still in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed near the highs but still below key resistance pegged at 10.50 basis March.
Dealers said the contract will need to pierce the key level in order to rack up further gains since it twice reached but failed to take out 10.50 in March, last week.
A dearth of physical offtake continues to plague the market. While new sugar freight inquiries were noted, fixtures remain thin.
March closed up 0.11 to 10.46, having ranged from 10.48 to 10.34. The back months settled 0.06 to 0.04 firmer.
Volume was estimated at a light 7,547 lots.
Refiner buying buoyed prices early, dealers said.
